    • generateAndProtectMessage

      public static org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.PKIMessage generateAndProtectMessage(HeaderProvider headerProvider, ProtectionProvider protectionProvider, org.bouncycastle.asn1.x509.GeneralName newRecipient, org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.PKIBody body, List<org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.CMPCertificate> issuingChain) throws GeneralSecurityException, IOException
      generate and protect a new CMP message
